verbatim_quote.original: در کل میخوام طوری باشه یه instance از opencode بالا باشه و همه mcp ها هم فقط یک instance داشته باشن و و یک instance از openchamber هم باشه دیگه بین همه سشن ها و پروژها مشتکر باشه mcp سرورها
verbatim_quote.english_translation: In general I want one instance of opencode running, all MCPs having only a single instance, and one openchamber instance too — shared across all sessions and projects, the MCP servers.

extracted_decision.summary: One shared OpenCode instance + one MCP-server instance per server + one OpenChamber instance across all sessions/projects.
extracted_decision.rationale: Avoids per-session server duplication and resource waste across the workspace.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Major consolidation; requires a remote/singleton transport rollout.
